PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

Eng. Muhammad Abdul Rahman Abdul Wahab Abdul Rahman

Senior Geologist · Data Analyst · Pressure Engineer · Mud Logging Specialist

Senior geologist and data analyst with more than 20 years of professional experience across geology, gold mining, oil and gas operations, mud logging, pressure engineering and geological data analysis. His CV records international field experience across Sudan, Iran, Syria, Yemen, Iraq, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates.
